name: Tekkai
description: One of the Six Powers (Rokushiki): rooted hardening, then moving while hardened, then hardening as a counter.

stages.name: Rooted hardening
stages.text: You managed Tekkai for the first time: rooted hardening.

stages.name: Moving while hardened
stages.text: Tekkai came to you without thinking now: moving while hardened.

stages.name: Hardening as a counter
stages.description: Tekkai mastered: hardening as a counter.
stages.text: You had mastered Tekkai: hardening as a counter.
